choices.rationale: Reproducible cloud development with repository policy close to code.
choices.reversalTrigger: A managed environment offers materially better reproducibility and security.

choices.rationale: Environment-scoped runtime injection and centralized access control.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Committed env files and manually copied secrets
choices.reversalTrigger: Doppler cannot satisfy identity, audit, rotation, or availability requirements.

choices.rationale: Managed application runtime aligned with the current Kit operating model.
choices.reversalTrigger: Measured reliability, security, region, or cost requirements are unmet.

choices.rationale: Shared organization-aware identity with first-party product journeys.
choices.reversalTrigger: WorkOS cannot meet accepted security or product requirements.

choices.rationale: Portable Postgres semantics with explicit typed schema and migrations.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Prisma as the canonical ORM and Replit-hosted databases
choices.reversalTrigger: The pair cannot meet correctness, portability, or operational needs.

choices.rationale: Direct object transfer and governed durable storage without repository bloat.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Large masters in Git or server-proxied uploads
choices.reversalTrigger: Required residency, lifecycle, or reliability controls are unavailable.

choices.rationale: Direct governed video upload and delivery.
choices.reversalTrigger: Required workflow, quality, security, or economics are unmet.

choices.rationale: Transactional delivery with an explicit product-owned email contract.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Provider-specific email logic spread through products
choices.reversalTrigger: Delivery, compliance, or regional requirements are unmet.

choices.rationale: Shared error and performance telemetry with redaction controls.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Logs as the only production diagnostic
choices.reversalTrigger: Telemetry quality, privacy, or cost becomes unacceptable.

choices.rationale: Typed application transport over shared authorized procedures.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Business rules embedded directly in route handlers
choices.reversalTrigger: A different transport demonstrably improves portability without duplicating policy.

choices.rationale: Portable primitive tool exposure independent of model runtime.
choices.reversalTrigger: An open replacement achieves broader portable interoperability.

choices.rationale: Current configurable model integration without owning capability architecture.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Hard-coding a single model provider into domain procedures
choices.reversalTrigger: Current official evidence shows a better portable runtime fit.

choices.rationale: Composable source-owned components, semantic styling, and one coherent icon grammar.
choices.rejectedAlternative: Opaque component packages and mixed icon libraries
choices.reversalTrigger: The stack blocks accepted accessibility or product-expression requirements.
